summary.text: Emily Thompson is the Republican candidate for Delaware State Senate District 15 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat Nisha Lodhavia in a race with no incumbent.
A state government program manager, she lives on her family farm in Hartly.

paragraphs.text: Emily Thompson graduated from Dover High School and earned a graduate degree from Wilmington University.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Thompson said she was raised on a multi-generational farming and small business family farm in Hartly, and that she earned undergraduate and graduate degrees at Wilmington University as well as a Doctor of Social Science in Prevention Science.
She said she has worked for nearly a decade in state government and currently oversees programs promoting the development and well-being of children and families.
Thompson listed her campaign priorities as supporting agriculture and small businesses, stronger education and early intervention, and responsible government spending.
